description:
SCAV-CO adds loads of combat salvaging ships, very deadly pirate ships and a few new hull-mods and portraits.

Update 8: Reworked Ultima, New SCAV-CO style and a ship! Total description overhaul, a few new portraits.

Probably save compatible!

aiDescription: Adds a variety of combat salvage ships, deadly pirate vessels, and a few new hull modifications and portraits. Includes a reworked version of the Ultima ship, a new SCAV-CO visual style, and updated descriptions. Some portraits are intended for player use only and are not used in NPC fleets.
